youtube.aciklama: In vestibular nystagmus, the eye first drifts slowly, then snaps back with a corrective jump from the brainstem. Because the fast phase is easier to see, direction is named after it; in acute unilateral peripheral loss, nystagmus usually beats toward the healthy side.

cumleler: In nystagmus, the eye drifts slowly, then jumps back quickly.
With sudden left labyrinth loss, the VOR drifts the eyes slowly left.
The fast phase then jumps the eyes back to the right.
Direction is named by the easier-to-see fast phase: right-beating nystagmus.
In acute unilateral peripheral loss, nystagmus usually beats toward the healthy side.
